image_description: A large pipe organ situated in a stone-walled interior, likely a church or hall. The instrument features a prominent wooden case with three distinct sections of vertical pipes: a central block of shorter, dense metallic pipes flanked by two taller sections of pipes behind decorative wooden grilles. Below the pipe array is a console area with multiple stacked keyboards (manuals) and stop controls, illuminated by warm artificial lighting. A pedalboard is visible at the base.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Multiple rows of vertical metal or wooden pipes of varying heights arranged symmetrically.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image clearly shows a symmetrical arrangement of pipes. The central section has short vertical pipes, while the side sections have taller pipes behind grilles, creating a varied height profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pipe heights range from very short compact pipes to dramatically towering pipes creating a dramatic stepped silhouette.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a clear contrast between the short central pipes and the taller side pipes, creating a stepped visual effect typical of organ facades.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Console with one or more stacked keyboards (manuals) plus pedalboard at floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The console is visible in the lower foreground. Multiple horizontal tiers suggest stacked manuals. A dark, curved structure at the very bottom indicates the presence of a pedalboard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Stop knobs or tablets arranged on either side of keyboards.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Vertical rows of small, light-colored protrusions are visible on the angled panels flanking the keyboards, consistent with stop knobs or tablets.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Pedalboard at floor level for foot-operated notes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A curved, dark wooden structure with radial keys is visible at the base of the console, matching the appearance of an organ pedalboard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ornate carved wood case with decorative moldings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The organ case is made of wood with visible paneling, moldings, and a decorative crest at the top center. The side towers feature lattice/grille work.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Polished tin, lead alloy, or wood pipes with reflective metallic or stained finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The central pipes appear metallic with some reflectivity under the warm light. The surrounding structure is clearly stained wood.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large keyboard instrument with pipe array.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The combination of the massive pipe facade and the complex console confirms this is a large keyboard instrument.
All functional components (pipes, manuals, stops, pedals) are present and correctly assembled for a musical instrument.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The individual pipes in the central cluster lack distinct separation and definition; they blend into a somewhat 'mushy' texture rather than showing crisp cylindrical edges, likely due to AI generation smoothing or low resolution simulation.

The stop knobs on the side panels are irregular in shape and spacing. Some appear to merge into the wood paneling or lack the distinct mechanical geometry of real organ stops, appearing more like painted details than physical objects.
The curvature and key alignment of the pedalboard seem slightly inconsistent with standard ergonomic designs, appearing somewhat flattened or warped in perspective.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific classification of the instrument as a pipe organ and distinguish it from other keyboard instruments or architectural elements.
To audit the boundaries of individual pipes in the central cluster to detect fusion or melting artifacts where pipes should be distinct entities.
To verify the spatial relationship between the console, the pipe array, and the background wall, ensuring no geometric bleeding or impossible depth cues.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle textural anomalies in the wood and metal surfaces.

focus_areas: Distinctness of individual pipes in the central facade
Geometric regularity and mechanical plausibility of stop knobs
Structural integrity of the pedalboard keys
Boundary sharpness between the organ case and the stone wall background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the central pipe cluster. In AI-generated organs, these often melt together. Verify if the topology auditor finds distinct cylinders or a fused mass. Also, check if the stop knobs have consistent geometry or if they degrade into noise/irregular blobs. The pedalboard is often a failure point for perspective; ensure the keys follow a logical radial pattern.
